title: Thyrocare collaborates with Ameelio Healthcare to launch new diagnostic lab in Kurnool
summary: Thyrocare further strengthens its diagnostic network in Andhra Pradesh, marking its 3rd laboratory in the state.
thbAction: Pitch THB's diagnostics CRM to help labs manage doctor outreach, collection-center expansion, and B2B referral relationships while improving conversion and retention.
contentHtml:
Thyrocare further strengthens its diagnostic network in Andhra Pradesh, marking its 3rd laboratory in the state.

Thyrocare Technologies, a leading healthcare diagnostics company in India, has announced the launch of its new diagnostic laboratory in Kurnool, Andhra Pradesh, in collaboration with Ameelio Healthcare Private Limited. With this launch, Thyrocare further strengthens its diagnostic network in Andhra Pradesh, marking its 3rd laboratory in the state. The facility was inaugurated by Piyush Singh, Vice President, Thyrocare Technologies. The launch marks another step in Thyrocare’s efforts towards strengthening its diagnostic network and improving the accessibility of affordable and reliable diagnostic services across emerging markets.

The laboratory is equipped to cater to routine as well as specialised diagnostic testing requirements and is supported by trained professionals, helping address the evolving healthcare needs of healthcare partners and patients in the region.

The collaboration with Ameelio Healthcare further strengthens Thyrocare’s local presence in Kurnool, expanding the reach of its advanced and affordable diagnostic services in Andhra Pradesh. The facility will help people in Kurnool and neighbouring regions access quality diagnostic services, supported by timely sample processing and delivery of diagnostic reports.

The expansion aligns with Thyrocare’s continued focus on strengthening its presence beyond key metropolitan markets and building a more accessible and extensive diagnostic network.

Sharing his thoughts on the launch of the new diagnostic laboratory in Kurnool, Rahul Guha, MD and CEO, API Holdings & Thyrocare Technologies said, “At Thyrocare, we believe access to reliable diagnostics should not be limited by geography. The launch of our laboratory in Kurnool, in collaboration with Ameelio Healthcare, is an important step towards bringing quality diagnostic services closer to more communities. As we expand our network, we remain focused on making testing affordable and accessible while supporting the growing diagnostic needs of patients and healthcare partners.”

Rajdeep Panwar, Chief Commercial Officer, Thyrocare Technologies said, “Our expansion into Kurnool reflects our continued effort to build a stronger diagnostic network across emerging markets. Our association with Ameelio Healthcare Private Limited will help us serve the region more effectively and improve access to dependable testing services. We will continue to focus on consistent quality standards, timely reporting and affordability as we extend our reach to more patients and healthcare partners.”

With the launch of its new laboratory in Kurnool, Thyrocare continues to strengthen its diagnostic footprint across India, with a focus on expanding access to standard and affordable testing beyond the metro markets.
